title: This Beetle Launches Itself at 300 Times Gravity

scenes.text: A beetle launches itself at three hundred times gravity.
Flip a click beetle on its back and it can't use its legs.
So it snaps a hinge in its body. The click is the sound, and the whole motion takes under a millisecond.
It shoots upward more than twenty body lengths. That's like you jumping over a ten-storey building.
Fighter pilots black out at nine g. This bug takes three hundred and doesn't notice.

description:
A click beetle launches at over 300 times gravity using a spring-loaded hinge in its body.
It can jump more than 20 body lengths with no legs at all.
Could you jump over a building without legs?
first_comment: If you could pick a bug's superpower for a day, which one?
